cands.title: File:Baba Vida Klearchos 3 prison cell.jpg
cands.artist: Klearchos Kapoutsis from Paleo Faliro, Athens, Greece
cands.desc: Stairs leading to a prison cell - Baba Vida is a medieval fortress in Vidin in northwestern Bulgaria and the town's primary landmark. It consists of two fundamental walls and four towers and is said to be the only entirely preserved medieval castle in the country.
